name: Electric Logo
description: WebGL logo effect that traces any image outline and draws crackling electric arcs and a glow around it, with cursor-reactive sparks and click pulses.
contents: Single container div that fills its parent and hosts a WebGL canvas
Logo outline traced from an image (default lightning bolt SVG)
behavior: Traces the image edge into a distance field and renders electric arcs and glow in a fragment shader
Random arcs spawn along the outline; arcs flicker and crackle
Cursor hover attracts sparks near the pointer, click or tap sends a pulse and burst
Morphs smoothly when the src changes
Pauses rendering when scrolled out of view
Respects prefers-reduced-motion by disabling click pulses and reducing motion

props.name: src
props.default: built-in lightning bolt SVG data URL

editableByProps: Arc and glow colors, intensity, thickness, strands, bend, crackle, flicker, fill
Logo scale, animation speed, arc frequency
Cursor interactivity, cursor strength and radius
Dark or light theme, container class and style

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the number of simultaneous arcs or click pulses
needsCodeEdit.where: ARCS and PULSES constants at the top of the file

needsCodeEdit.change: Change tracing resolution or render pixel limit

needsCodeEdit.where: Renderer dpr setting and the dpr line in the resize function

fixed: Requires the ogl package and WebGL2 support (GLSL 300 es shaders)
Container fills its parent (w-full h-full), so the parent needs a defined size
Image is loaded with crossOrigin anonymous, so remote logos need CORS headers
Logo must be a transparent image or one with a uniform background, shape is detected from alpha or edge color
Device pixel ratio capped at 2 and total pixels capped at about 4 million
Outline sampling is capped at about 3000 edge points
Pointer events are attached to the container only, no global listeners
Not meaningfully usable on touch for hover, only tap pulses work; renders fine on small screens if the container has size
